mentions.name: Beeldplek
mentions.description: A timelapse platform powered by community photos: a mount and QR code are placed at fixed viewpoints around the neighbourhood, and people scan the code, photograph the view, optionally add their name, and submit. The infrastructure is up and running while the permit for placing the mounts is pending.
mentions.source_excerpt: Another project is https://www.beeldplek.nl, a timelapse platform powered by community photos. The idea is to place a mount and QR code at fixed viewpoints around the neighbourhood. People scan, photograph the view, optionally add their name, and submit. The infrastructure is up and running but getting the permit to place the mount has been a slow process so far.
